path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
振り飛車相手では角が端の銀の進路に利いていることがあります。１五へ銀を出す前に、相手の角と端歩、自分の１六の歩の支えを確認しましょう。端を止められたら３筋の歩交換から銀を斜めに進める順が候補になります。

３五の銀を歩で追われても２筋の歩突きで反撃する手があります。銀を取ると歩成りから角を狙われるかを読みます。相手が３筋の歩を取らなければ、飛車を３筋へ振って角頭に飛車・銀・歩の利きを集中する構想もあります。
intro.en:
Against Ranging Rook, the bishop may cover the square your silver wants on the edge. Before advancing, inspect that diagonal, the enemy edge pawn, and support from your own pawn. A blocked edge can make a third-file pawn exchange and diagonal silver advance more suitable. The actual defenders determine which route works.

A rook-file pawn push can counter a pawn attacking your silver on the third file. Calculate whether taking the silver allows promotion against the bishop. If the opponent declines the third-file exchange, moving your rook onto that file can concentrate rook, silver, and pawn against the bishop’s head. Do not treat an advanced silver alone as proof of success.

question.ja: 端の銀の進路を妨げる大駒は？
question.en: Which major piece can obstruct the edge silver?

answer.ja: 斜線で銀の進出地点を狙う相手の角です。
answer.en: The enemy bishop can cover the silver’s intended square along its diagonal.

child.commentEn:
Figure 2-2: The silver gets captured for free
If you play ▲1五銀, it is captured by △同角. This occurs when the opponent's bishop is on 3三, and it is easy to overlook, so be careful.

child.comment:
図2-1 ▲9五銀から攻めたいが…
銀を端から使って攻めるのが棒銀の基本ですが、結論から言うとこの攻め筋はほとんどの場合うまくいきません。まずシンプルに▲1五銀と出る手はどうでしょうか。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: You want to attack with ▲9五銀, but...
Attacking with the silver from the edge is the basic Climbing Silver line, but to conclude, this attack mostly fails here. What about simply advancing ▲1五銀?
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.title: 棒銀vs振り飛車の基本: 図1-1 棒銀vs四間飛車の基本図 → 図3-5 銀は取られたが、角を取り返せる
courses.titleEn: Climbing Silver versus Ranging Rook: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Climbing Silver vs Fourth File Rook → Figure 3-5: The silver is captured, but the bishop can be recaptured
courses.goalFormation:
図3-5 銀は取られたが、角を取り返せる
図3-4から銀を取られましたが、▲2三歩成の攻めが強烈です。次に相手がどう指しても角を取れるうえ、飛車を成り込んで攻める手も見えます。一瞬銀を取られて損しますが、すぐ角を取れるので駒得です。図3-4から△2四同歩としてきても、▲同銀で棒銀がよしです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

child.comment:
図3-5 銀は取られたが、角を取り返せる
図3-4から銀を取られましたが、▲2三歩成の攻めが強烈です。次に相手がどう指しても角を取れるうえ、飛車を成り込んで攻める手も見えます。一瞬銀を取られて損しますが、すぐ角を取れるので駒得です。図3-4から△2四同歩としてきても、▲同銀で棒銀がよしです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-5: The silver is captured, but the bishop can be recaptured
From Figure 3-4 the silver is lost, but the ▲2三歩成 attack is powerful. Whatever the opponent plays next, the bishop can be taken, and promoting the rook to attack is also in view. The silver loss is momentary, as the bishop is won right away for a material gain. Even if White plays △2四同歩 from Figure 3-4, ▲同銀 is good for Climbing Silver.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: 銀取りに構わず攻める
section.en: Attack ignoring the threat to the silver

child.comment:
図3-4 銀取りを無視して攻める
銀が取られそうですが、無視して▲2四歩と攻める手が成立します。ここからさらに数手進めます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-4: Ignore the silver threat and attack
The silver seems to be lost, but ignoring it and attacking with ▲2四歩 works. Play a few more moves from here.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: 銀取りに構わず攻める
section.en: Attack ignoring the threat to the silver

child.comment:
図3-3 角頭を守る受け
図3-2から相手は△3四歩と打ってきました。ここに歩を打ってこなければ、次に棒銀側から▲3四歩と打って一気に勝勢です。この手は角頭を守りつつこちらの銀を攻める手です。ここで銀取りから逃げずに攻める手を考えます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-3: Defense protecting the bishop's head
From Figure 3-2 the opponent drops △3四歩. Without it, Black would drop ▲3四歩 next and win at once. This move defends the bishop's head while attacking our silver. Now look for a move that attacks instead of fleeing the silver attack.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: 銀が5段目に出れれば攻めが決まる
section.en: If the silver reaches the fifth rank, the attack is decided

child.comment:
図3-2 この形になれば必勝形
図3-1から相手が△同歩と取れば、こちらの銀が3五に進出できます。図3-2のように銀が五段目まで出た形は、棒銀が優勢と覚えておきましょう。さらに数手進めて、棒銀の攻めが決まるのを見ます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-2: This shape is a winning shape
If the opponent captures with △同歩 from Figure 3-1, our silver can advance to 3五. A shape with the silver out to the fifth rank, as in Figure 3-2, is favourable for Climbing Silver. Play a few more moves and watch the attack land.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: 銀が5段目に出れれば攻めが決まる
section.en: If the silver reaches the fifth rank, the attack is decided

child.comment:
図3-1 3筋からの攻めが本命
今度は▲3五歩と3筋から攻めます。対振り飛車の棒銀は、このように3筋から攻めるのが基本です。△3三角と上がる形では、角の頭の3四の地点が弱点になりやすいので、積極的に狙います。相手の角の正面の3四は「角頭」と呼ばれる弱点です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-1: The real attack is from the 3rd file
This time attack from the 3rd file with ▲3五歩. Against Ranging Rook, Climbing Silver basically attacks from the 3rd file like this. When the bishop is on 3三, its head at 3四 tends to be a weakness, so aim at it actively. The square in front of the bishop, 3四, is a weakness called the bishop's head (角頭).
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: ▲3五歩 is the basic attacking line

child.comment:
図2-3 端歩も突き返されると効果なし
▲1五銀とする前に▲1六歩と突いておくのが工夫の一手で、次に▲1五銀、△同角に対して▲同歩と角を取り返す手を作っています。しかし▲1六歩に△1四歩とされると手がなくなります。振り飛車相手に棒銀を狙うとき、1筋からの攻めは失敗しやすいと覚えておきましょう。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-3: Pushing the edge pawn back has no effect either
Pushing ▲1六歩 before ▲1五銀 is a clever idea, preparing to answer ▲1五銀 △同角 with ▲同歩 recapturing the bishop. But if White answers ▲1六歩 with △1四歩, Black has nothing. When using Climbing Silver against Ranging Rook, remember that attacking on the 1st file easily fails.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.
